text:
erin: Quick postmortem follow-up for BlueHarbor (dedicated/private). Short RC: maintenance peering change -> transient BGP flap -> on-prem NAT failover -> asymmetric return path hit an isolation bug. We need owners, clear due dates, and a short validation drill that we can run with the customer's SRE. Prefer confirmations by EOD.

marco: I can take the peering healthcheck + CI gate. Plan: add a nightly BGP neighbor sanity check + a pre-deploy hook to run on config pushes. Target: 2024-09-10.

priya: I'll run the NAT failover drill with the customer and validate their topology (especially RNAT paths). Proposed drill slot: 2024-09-12 09:30 PT. I'll grab a staging endpoint and coordinate with oncall.

dan: I'll own the isolation bug backport and staged rollout. Will gate behind a feature flag and monitor canary customers for 48h. ETA: 2024-09-08 (PR) and rollout 2024-09-11.

erin: Staging host: blueharbor-staging-peers.svc.redwood:11777. Capture tcpdump/pcap and upload to /artifacts/blueharbor/pcaps. Note: tag captures with customer:blueharbor.

marco: Suggest adding an alert: "peer_flap_rate > 3/min" that annotates recent peering config pushes and triggers a runbook step to rollback if flaps persist > 2min. I'll add the alert and link to runbook.

priya: Also recommend a quick symmetric-path synthetic check we can run nightly for Dedicated tenants: send small probe and verify return ASN/next-hop. If mismatch, create ticket.

dan: For the backport, I'll include a canary checklist: 
- feature flag on
- 5% canary (dedicated) for 24h
- metric watch: request error rate, tail latency, peer flaps, asymmetric-path alerts

marco: BGP check snippet for infra libs:

```
#!/bin/bash
# bgp-neighbor-check.sh
vtysh -c 'show ip bgp neighbors' | grep -E 'Neighbor|Last update|State' || exit 1
```

infra-bot: Alert provisioned: /alerts/peer-flap-rate (threshold=3/min). Runbook linked: /runbooks/dedicated-peering-isolation.

erin: Consolidated action items (please confirm):
- marco: peering healthcheck + CI gate + alert wiring (owner:marco) / due: 2024-09-10
- priya: on-prem NAT failover drill with customer + captures (owner:priya) / due: 2024-09-12
- dan: isolation bug backport + feature-flagged rollout (owner:dan) / due: 2024-09-11
- infra-bot: create alert + annotate runbook (owner:infra-bot) / due: 2024-09-07

If you want to reassign anything, reply here. I'll add these rows to the recurring-incident tracker and mark this pattern as "asymmetric-return-isolation". We'll review progress in next remediation sync.

marco: Confirmed. I'll open PR and link here: https://github.com/redwood/networking/pull/1987

priya: Confirmed. I'll DM customer SRE to lock the drill slot.

dan: Confirmed. I'll post the rollout playbook once PR is up.

erin: Thanks everyone. If owners change, please update this thread so the tracker stays accurate.
